verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents JavaScript source map support for reversing minification. Its official CLI is documented for uploading files to improve stacktraces, which covers the core of uploading source maps from CI so production traces show original source. missing for 10: explicit docs tying the CLI upload to JavaScript source maps, any bundler plugin (webpack/Vite) evidence, CI pipeline guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload JavaScript source maps from CI — via CLI or bundler plugin — so production stack traces show my original source, not minified frames

citations.quote: The BugSnag error monitoring SDK supports using source maps to reverse JavaScript transformations.
The BugSnag CLI can be used to simplify the process of creating releases on the BugSnag dashboard and uploading files to improve the stacktraces in your errors.
